description.value: Maru Sushi (branded as Sushi Maru on its website) is a casual Japanese restaurant on Fraser Highway in Langley, focused on quality sushi made from premium fish and rice. The restaurant seats guests for lunch and dinner and is set up to host family dinners and birthday parties in a relaxed atmosphere. Online ordering is available for those wanting a quick takeout stop.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 16m; rack (3 spaces) at 35m. Total: 6 spaces.

The website features an 'Order Now' online ordering system, confirming takeout availability. No bike-specific amenities (parking, pump, charging, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website; the OSM name 'Maru Sushi' conflicts with the website's consistent branding of the business as 'Sushi Maru.'
